subject: Service disruption: proposal for compensation & remediation plan
content:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@innotech.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: InnoTech Billing <billing@innotech.io>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Increased latency and 4-hour outage window on July 3

Hi Neha,

We tracked a severe spike in inference latency and several failed calls across our production streams during the July 3 maintenance window. It lookslike downstream consumers saw up to 90% request degradation between 02:10-06:15 UTC and manual retries were required. This caused degradations in our chat product during a high-traffic period.

We need:
- A concise incident summary with timelines and root-cause (for our compliance team).
- Proposed commercial remediation (credits/discount or free months) to make whole the impacted period.

Please escalate — our Q3 launch has margins that are sensitive to lost SLAs.

Thanks,
Daniel
VP Product, InnoTech

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@innotech.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Increased latency and 4-hour outage window on July 3

Hi Daniel — thanks for flagging and sorry for the disruption.

Short version: we observed a cascading KV-cache regeneration bug combined with an autoscaler misfire when a control-plane rollout overlapped a high-qps prefix, which amplified per-token latency. Our on-call SREs captured trace spans and we have a draft incident summary attached.

Immediate next steps I suggest:
1) I’ll escalate to Ops & Finance to request a one-time remediation package.
2) We propose a provisional remedy (pending exec approval): two months of service credit equivalent to 40% of June usage or a capped $35k credit, whichever is lower.
3) We’ll schedule a technical postmortem with your SREs and provide a timeline for the KV-cache patch and a permanent autoscaler guardrail.

Attached: incident_summary_20260705.pdf (draft).

I’ll loop in my manager and finance for approval. I’ll update you within 48 hours with a formal offer.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0193

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: InnoTech outage — request for remediation package (INN-8342)

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding InnoTech’s ask. Key facts:
- Impact window: 2026-07-03T02:10:00Z — 2026-07-03T06:15:00Z.
- Estimated billable tokens affected: customer reports high error rate but we should use June usage as baseline.
- Customer request: formal incident summary + commercial remediation (credits/free months).
- Proposed by AE (me): two months of 40% credit or capped $35k.

Attachments: incident_summary_20260705.pdf (draft), sleuth traces in incident bucket.

Please advise: do we have precedent to offer a blended credit + service commitment (SRE-led review + 1:1 readiness session) instead of pure cash credits? I’d like to keep cap and avoid open-ended discounts if possible.

Thanks,
Neha

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: InnoTech outage — request for remediation package (INN-8342)

Neha — thanks for the clear framing. This reads like a high-impact SLA hit and we should treat it as an exec-approval ask. My recommendation:
- Commercial package we can present: 1) 40% credit on two billing cycles (applied to invoices) capped at $30k, OR 2) one free month plus 25% credit for the subsequent month if they prefer term extension.
- Additional (non-monetary) remediation: a prioritized SRE review, two proactive load tests with InnoTech, and a short-term reduced-rate concierge tier for 30 days.

Rationale: preserves predictable maximum liability while offering two acceptable options to the customer. Finance needs a quick nod; legal will require a short addendum.

Marissa — please confirm if Finance can clear a $30k cap and whether we need exec signoff above that. Rishi — if you’re available a quick thumbs-up would let us respond this afternoon.

Karthik
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Finance Ops <finance@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: InnoTech outage — request for remediation package (INN-8342)

Karthik — Finance can provisionally approve a $30k cap but needs the actual numbers: last 2 months spend, impacted token estimate, and how the credit will be applied (invoice offset vs one-line adjustment). Legal will need the compensation addendum language; please attach proposed terms.

Neha — can you confirm June invoice total and provide the token estimate (or allow us to compute from usage)? I’ll loop in Legal for a short addendum and expedite Docusign if Rishi greenlights.

Marissa
Director, Finance Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: InnoTech outage — request for remediation package (INN-8342)

Thanks team — I’m okay with the $30k capped credit option (40% x 2 cycles up to $30k) + SRE remediation plan. Two asks from my side:
1) We include a requirement that the customer signs the compensation addendum (DocuSign) within 14 days to accept the offer.
2) We require the SRE review to be scheduled within 10 business days and deliver a remediation timeline.

If Finance and Legal are aligned, proceed to send the offer to the customer. Keep the cap firm.

Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@innotech.io>
Cc: InnoTech Billing <billing@innotech.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, InnoTech Legal <legal@innotech.io>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Resolution proposal: capped credit + SRE remediation (INN-8342)

Hi Daniel — thanks for your patience. Executive approval has been secured. Below is the formal remediation we can offer: 

Proposal (choose one):
A) Commercial: 40% service credit applied to two successive billing cycles, capped at $30,000 total. Credit will be applied as an invoice offset within your next two invoices after acceptance.
B) Term option: one free month of service + 25% credit on the following month (for customers who prefer term extension).

Non-monetary (included with either option):
- A prioritized SRE-led remediation review with your team within 10 business days.
- Two joint load tests (pre-production) at no charge.
- A 30-day concierge support window with a named SRE contact.

Conditions:
- Offer is contingent on execution of a short compensation addendum by InnoTech via DocuSign within 14 days.
- Offer is capped at $30k if option A is selected.

Attached: proposed_compensation_terms.docx; incident_summary_20260705.pdf; sre_remediation_plan.md
DocuSign link (proposed addendum): https://www.docusign.com/INN-8342/compensation
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Please confirm which option you prefer and we’ll send the addendum for signature and schedule the SRE kickoff.

Thanks again,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
